name: product-catalogue
description: Extensible product catalogue with a React frontend and hexagonal Node.js backend

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @catalogue/contracts && npm run build --workspace @catalogue/backend && npm run build --workspace @catalogue/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @catalogue/backend" "npm run dev --workspace @catalogue/frontend"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @catalogue/backend && npm run test --workspace @catalogue/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @catalogue/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @catalogue/backend && npm run typecheck --workspace @catalogue/frontend
